variables.name: multi_perspective_analysis
variables.description: Analysis from all models trying all perspectives

supersteps.description: Every model analyzes from every perspective (3 models × 4 perspectives = 12 workers)

perspectives.instruction: Analyze the security implications. Predict what a security expert would identify as: (1) attack vectors, (2) data exposure risks, (3) compliance concerns. Be specific about potential vulnerabilities.
Analyze the user experience implications. Predict what a UX designer would identify as: (1) usability issues, (2) accessibility concerns, (3) friction points. Focus on end-user impact.
Analyze the performance implications. Predict what a performance engineer would identify as: (1) scalability bottlenecks, (2) latency concerns, (3) resource utilization issues.
Analyze the maintainability implications. Predict what a senior engineer would identify as: (1) code complexity, (2) technical debt, (3) long-term maintenance challenges.

supersteps.description: Synthesize all perspectives into balanced recommendation

workers.instruction: Review all perspectives from different models. Identify consensus, conflicts, and unique insights. Synthesize into a balanced recommendation.

reduce_phase.chairman_instructions: Based on the comprehensive multi-perspective analysis (security, UX, performance, maintainability) from multiple models, provide a balanced final recommendation. Acknowledge trade-offs and prioritize concerns based on their importance.
